about: The Maps-tab step (design §2 C, ruling D-3): agency park pages opened with a real browser, allow-listed hosts only, 1 page per 3 s, max 300 pages a run. hosts = park pages we open; files = hosts a kept map link may live on. patterns = the agency's own PDF host by known URL pattern ({slug} = the park name, letters only, kind words stripped): one HEAD per park.
